step1_analysis.description: A high-gain single-ended regulated (gain-boosted) cascode amplifier. It uses auxiliary common-source amplifiers to regulate the cascode nodes, significantly increasing the output impedance and DC gain, which is essential for high-accuracy pipelined ADC stages.

paper_reference.title: A 10-b 30-MS/s Low-Power Pipelined CMOS A/D Converter Using a Pseudodifferential Architecture

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id_total = Id(XM3) + Id(XM6) + Id(XM7). With VBP=0.99V, Vsg=0.81V, Id ~ 37.5uA per branch. Total current ~ 111uA. Power = 1.8V * 111uA = 200uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 PMOS square law model with given bias voltages.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm1 * Rout. Rout is boosted by the auxiliary amplifiers. Intrinsic gain per stage ~ 40dB. Total gain ~ 3 stages (main + cascode + boost) = 120dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Regulated cascodes typically achieve 100+ dB gain, necessary for 10-bit settling accuracy.

ugbw.description: Unity Gain Bandwidth with a 1pF load.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm1 / (2*pi*CL). gm1 ~ 468uS. CL = 1pF. UGBW = 468u / (2*pi*1p) = 74.5 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A 30 MS/s ADC typically requires an op-amp bandwidth of 3-5 times the sampling frequency.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant poles at the cascode nodes and the auxiliary amplifier poles.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard stability requirement for closed-loop MDAC operation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, open-loop gain, UGBW, and phase margin. It uses a large inductor in feedback to auto-bias the amplifier in its high-gain region for robust AC analysis.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Regulated Cascode Amplifier Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N4 VIN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VOUT N2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUT N3 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Load Capacitor
CL VOUT 0 1p

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBP VBP 0 0.99
VVBN VBN 0 0.54

* AC Input Source
VAC VIN_AC 0 DC 0 AC 1

* DC Feedback for Auto-Biasing in High-Gain Region
* Forces VOUT = VIN at DC, while isolating AC signals
L1 VOUT VIN 1G
C1 VIN_AC VIN 1G

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(VOUT)
  
  ac dec 100 1k 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUT)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT))
  
  meas ac dc_gain max gain_db
  meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_margin find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
.endc
.end
